> A 2-wheeler, self-balancing, smart robot powered by an ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 module. It integrates sensor arrays (such as the MPU6050 IMU and DS3231 RTC), motor drivers (DRV8833PWP), local storage (MicroSD card), user input controls (tactile buttons and rotary encoders), and power management to create a smart robot.
